rationale: Pre-impl sufficiency was assessed through the architect/PM review in this session. Seven implementation-spec blockers were identified, amended, and revalidated before lock: NotifyEvent inbox_event keying, technical_metadata for long-tail fields, INBOX rendered annotation without duplicate raw entries, dual sidecar merge paths, public scrub_secrets live redaction helper, token-only command validation without handler invocation, and inline embed color literals instead of a missing dp-tokens.css dependency. After those amendments, schema validation and plan_loader.load() both pass and no blocking sufficiency gaps remain.
